title: Phase 5 — OCR spend telemetry + per-user daily cap
description:
Vision calls cost ~$0.003/image. Today no quota, no usage record.

Add:
- New OcrUsage table: (userId, day, imagesProcessed, callsMade) — daily aggregate (Prisma migration)
- Increment on each runLotVision call where imagesProcessed > 0
- Soft cap via OCR_DAILY_IMAGES_PER_USER env (default 100). When exceeded → 429 from /ocr-suggestions with message
- GET /api/lots/_admin/ocr-usage to inspect across users

Files: prisma/schema.prisma, server/src/services/lotVisionAi.ts, server/src/routes/lots.ts.
See task_plan.md Phase 5, findings.md G4.
